nodes.label: Primary Key Strategy (identity vs UUID)
nodes.rationale: Random UUIDv4 keys scatter inserts across the index and fragment it; bigint identity is sequential, 8 bytes and SQL-standard (preferred over serial). Distributed or externally exposed IDs should use a time-ordered form instead.

nodes.label: Time-Ordered IDs (UUIDv7 / ULID / time-prefixed)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the locality benefit of a sequential key while remaining generatable outside a single database; UUIDv7 needs the pg_uuidv7 extension, a time-prefixed text id needs none.
